current_text.html: Minutes of the permanent Committee or Agency shall be submitted to the committee of commissioners for review. Copies of the minutes shall be sent by the Stated Clerk to the members of committees of commissioners one month prior to the opening of the General Assembly.

relationships.title: Documenting and Reporting a Minister's Stated Differences with the Standards

occurrences.excerpt: The CCB found the proposed RAO amendment in conflict with BCO 21-4 because its reporting requirements failed to cover all possible presbytery responses to candidates' stated differences with the Standards.

relationships.title: Subscription and Exceptions of Substance

occurrences.excerpt: The CCB found no conflict, though a minority held that requiring presbyteries to record doctrinal disagreements would erode their exclusive authority to determine subscription under BCO 21-5.

relationships.title: Exceptions to Westminster Standards or BCO Recorded in Presbytery Minutes

occurrences.excerpt: The CCB answered no: neither the PCA constitution nor the RAO then required a presbytery to record a minister's exceptions to the Westminster Standards or BCO in its minutes.
